observation: Revenue fell 9.9% to £1,459.1m, volume 3.4%, EBITDA 1.7% to £177.9m, operating profit 11.5% and underlying profit before tax 14.0%, with weaker European paper markets and an SBR asset-network review. already_announced_exclusion: The cost-reduction programmes, SBR latex asset-network review, OMNOVA acquisition and related rights issue, and Ribécourt and Kluang restructuring activity disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Broad revenue, volume and profit deterioration and an explicit network review create moderate pressure, but stable unit margins, sharply stronger cash generation and the move to net cash provide strong quantified offsets.

availability_evidence: Annual report page 135 states that the financial statements were approved by the Board of Directors and authorised for issue on 12 March 2024; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: A prolonged industry downturn reduced continuing revenue from £2.3bn to £2.0bn, continuing EBITDA from £253.8m to £142.1m, EBITDA margin from 10.9% to 7.2% and underlying profit before tax from a £123.7m profit to a £27.2m loss. Year-end leverage remained 4.2x. Free Cash Flow nevertheless rose 24% to £85.7m, while a £276m rights issue, divestments and cash measures halved net debt to £499.7m.
already_announced_exclusion: The £276m rights issue, completed and ongoing divestment programme, five-site footprint reduction, cost and cash measures, headcount reductions, site closures and 2023 restructuring charges disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: The exceptional industry downturn, sharp EBITDA and margin contraction, underlying loss and still-high leverage create severe underlying pressure. Positive Free Cash Flow and major deleveraging are meaningful offsets, but much of the debt reduction came from already-announced equity and divestment actions.
